مَأْطُورَةٌ A bow. (A.) ―
-b2- A milking-vessel of skin (عُلْبَةٌ) for the head of which a twig is bent into the form of a hoop, and put round, after which its lip is covered; (K, TA;) or, sometimes, the edges of the skin of the علبة are folded upon the hoop-formed twig, and dry upon it. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
